solutions.title: ID Document Authenticity Check
solutions.subtitle: AI-powered verification of Pakistani identity documents

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: truID provides automated ID document authenticity checks to verify Pakistani identity documents during digital onboarding and identity verification. The solution combines AI-based document classification with multi-stage authenticity validation to determine whether a document is genuine or fraudulent.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Users receive a real-time, secure, and effortless verification result within seconds.

steps.title: ID Document Capture
steps.detail: The user brings the ID document in front of the mobile capture algorithm to detect the document and automatically captures it. The document image is passed to the truID verification engine for analysis.

steps.title: Document Classification
steps.detail: truID first determines whether the captured image is an ID document. If it is, the system automatically identifies the document type, such as Smart CNIC, Urdu CNIC, NICOP, or POC. Documents outside these categories are marked as unsupported.

steps.title: Template Matching
steps.detail: The system checks whether the document matches the correct template of a standard Pakistani ID card. Only documents that meet template requirements proceed to further verification.

steps.title: Deep Security Feature Inspection
steps.detail: truID performs detailed inspection of embedded security features to verify authenticity and detect potential tampering or misuse.

steps.title: Multi-Stage AI Validation
steps.detail: Multiple AI models work together to confirm that the document is genuine and unaltered. This layered validation eliminates the chances of photocopies, colored copies, or fake ID cards passing through the system.

keyFeatures.title: Automatic ID Document Classification
keyFeatures.description: truID automatically classifies captured ID documents and supports all major Pakistani identity cards, including Smart CNIC, Urdu CNIC, NICOP, and POC.

keyFeatures.title: AI-Based Template Matching
keyFeatures.description: The system first verifies whether the captured document matches the template of a standard Pakistani ID card.

keyFeatures.title: Deep Inspection of Security Features
keyFeatures.description: truID performs detailed inspection of embedded security features, including color-changing and disappearing holograms, silhouettes, logos, and textual elements.

keyFeatures.title: Multi-Stage AI Verification
keyFeatures.description: Multiple AI models are used to determine whether the document is an ID card, identify its type, and verify the authenticity of its security features.

keyFeatures.title: High Automation with Manual Review Support
keyFeatures.description: The verification process is fully automated in 98 percent of cases. In the remaining 2 percent, where there is any uncertainty, the document is flagged for manual verification to ensure correctness and compliance.

benefits: Automatic capturing and classification of ID documents
Support for all major Pakistani identity cards, including Smart CNIC, Urdu CNIC, NICOP, and POC
Identification of unsupported documents outside the supported ID types
AI-based template matching to validate standard ID formats
Deep inspection of security features
Multi-stage AI validation to confirm document originality
Detection and rejection of photocopies, colored copies, and counterfeit ID cards
Fully automated verification

solutions.title: Photo ID Selfie Matching
solutions.subtitle: AI-powered matching between ID photos and live selfies

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: truID provides secure and accurate matching of the photo on an ID document with the individual's live selfie. The system leverages AI to account for natural variations, including aging, skin color differences, changes in hair, and the presence of glasses or facial hair.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Users receive a real-time, secure, and effortless verification result within seconds.

steps.title: Capture ID Photo
steps.detail: The user captures an image of their ID document using a smartphone camera.

steps.title: Capture Live Selfie
steps.detail: The user captures a live selfie directly within the mobile application.

steps.title: Feature Extraction
steps.detail: Neural networks create intelligent embeddings from both the ID photo and the live selfie, encoding the critical facial features.

steps.title: Comparison and Matching
steps.detail: A comparison neural network evaluates the embeddings to detect differences and determine if the ID photo matches the live selfie.

steps.title: Verification Result
steps.detail: The system provides a confirmation of the match, ensuring the individual is the same as shown on the ID.

keyFeatures.description: truID compares the photo on an ID document directly with the live selfie captured during verification.

keyFeatures.title: AI-Powered Embeddings and Comparison
keyFeatures.description: The system uses neural networks to create embeddings from the ID photo and live selfie and compares them to accurately detect differences.

keyFeatures.description: The matching process accounts for natural changes in appearance, including facial hair, glasses or accessories, and aging.

solutions.title: Accurate OCR for Text Extraction
solutions.subtitle: AI-powered text extraction from ID documents

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: truID leverages AI and computer vision to perform automatic text extraction and parsing from ID documents. The solution supports both English and Urdu languages and converts raw text into structured key-value pairs for semantic understanding. This ensures accurate data capture while minimizing manual entry during digital verification.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Users receive a real-time, secure, and effortless verification result within seconds.

steps.title: Capture ID Document
steps.detail: The user captures an image of their ID document using a smartphone camera.

steps.title: Raw Text Extraction
steps.detail: truID extracts raw text characters from the captured image using AI-powered OCR.

steps.title: Cleaning and Validation
steps.detail: The system cleans the extracted text and performs validation checks to ensure accuracy.

steps.title: Key-Value Pair Generation
steps.detail: Extracted text is converted into structured key-value pairs, matching the document's geometry and layout.

steps.title: Data Delivery
steps.detail: Structured data is returned to the application for further processing, verification, or storage, with Urdu text sent securely to a third-party OCR API when needed.

keyFeatures.title: Automatic Text Extraction and Parsing

keyFeatures.title: Multi-Language Support
keyFeatures.description: truID supports English OCR offline and Urdu via a secure third-party API, sending only masked portions of the document to protect privacy.

keyFeatures.description: The OCR process extracts text and verifies that each data element is correctly positioned, using geometry and layout checks to ensure accurate extraction and organization of all document information.

solutions.title: Touchless Fingerprint Biometrics
solutions.subtitle: Smartphone-based fingerprint capture and verification

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: truID enables instantaneous, touchless fingerprint capture using any standard smartphone camera. The system converts captured fingerprints into high-quality scans suitable for identity verification.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Users receive a real-time, secure, and effortless verification result within seconds.

steps.title: Capture Fingerprint
steps.detail: Users capture their fingerprint through a smartphone camera using the truID mobile application.

steps.title: Quality Assessment
steps.detail: The system evaluates the captured fingerprint using the NFIQ2 quality metric to ensure it meets the required threshold for verification.

steps.title: Spoof Detection
steps.detail: truID automatically checks for spoof attempts using images or video to prevent fraudulent submissions.

steps.title: Format Conversion
steps.detail: Fingerprints are converted into WSQ or ISO formats, making them compatible with government verification systems.

steps.title: Database Matching
steps.detail: The high-quality fingerprint scan is matched against established government databases, such as NADRA in Pakistan, to verify identity.
